limitations: Get-Counter itself blocked about one second, so nominal one-second CPU sampling was actually approximately two-second sampling.

The same blocking doubled idle windows to approximately 62 seconds and quiet tails to approximately 24 seconds; this violates the exact 30s/12s timing protocol, so the run is not marked pass. Long wheel injection remained 1200 native events at 50ms cadence.
Responsiveness was not independently measured; CPU is not evidence of no UI lag.
AX marker regex sees the full accessibility tree (80 fixture rows), not just viewport-visible text; screenshot inspection is the viewport-completeness evidence.
Debug-dev Azure VM diagnostic only; synthetic AC/thermal state, not battery or device-age evidence.

Final frames reached rows 78-79; intermediate inspected frame showed rows 47-48 and per-trial unique image hashes demonstrate movement, but scrolling eventually reached the fixture bottom before the final event.

pageCoherenceAudit.definitions: Visible pages come from independent screenshot OCR PAGE A/B row markers. Stored text identity uses corresponding row markers (navigation-link text excluded). Window identity uses ScrollBench Page A/B title. A match is page identity only, not row completeness, temporal alignment or successful navigation.

eventFrameLinkAudit.definitions: Compare UI event ScrollBench Page A/B title with linked frame title and independently OCR-visible PAGE A/B row markers. Unknown, unlinked and dangling rows are separate. Match checks page identity only, not temporal freshness, row accuracy or navigation success.
